text: Hello everyone, nice to see you again.Welcome to our English class.Today, we will go over what we have learned in this unit, and try to introduce a great city at the end of this lesson.Before we start, please check if you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, and a pen.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,和笔。Okay, now let's start.You have already learned Unit 1.So today, Ms.Guo wants to give you a quiz.She has designed some quiz cards and put them in different boxes.If you can complete all the tasks in the first box, you can move on to the second one.Are you clear?Now, let's start from the smallest one, shall we?Okay, let's open it.Class, please look at the compass and tell me the directions.The first one.Yes, it's northeast.The second one.It's northwest.How about the third one?It's southeast.Then, do you know the last one?Right, it's southwest.Good.Let's go to the next stage.Look here.Can you read them correctly?Please take out your worksheet.Write down your answers in Task 1.Please pay attention.Some of them have more than one way to express.You will have one minute to prepare.Ready?Start.Have you finished?Now, let's check the answers together.Number one.It's 1,400 kilometers.Number two.2,060 kilometers.Number three.One hour and fifty minutes.Or we can say an hour and fifty minutes.Number four.Four hours and thirty minutes.And we can also say four and a half hours.Or four hours and a half.Well done.Let's move on to the next stage.Can you play the game?Just filling the blanks to complete the sentences.You can find the exercises in Task 2 on your worksheet.Two minutes to prepare.Are you ready?Okay, now start.One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.One, two, three, four.Okay, time is up.Let's check the answers together.A lot of people visit the Palace Museum in Beijing every day.Yes, the Palace Museum, palace.There are many huge department stores in Shanghai.Huge, huge.Kitty is reading some information about Bangkok.Information, information.And number four.Beijing is north of Shanghai, north.Number five.People in Tokyo love eating sushi.Sushi, sushi.And go on.Number six.Beijing and Tokyo are great cities in Asia.Asia.Number seven.Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.Capital, capital.Number eight.The Great Wall is a famous place in Beijing.Famous, famous.Number nine.Every tourist enjoys eating the fresh fruit in Bangkok.Tourist, tourist.The last one.The exhibition is about great cities in China.Exhibition, exhibition.Good job.So you have finished all the tasks in the first box.Now you can open the second box.Let's see what is waiting for us.Look at the map.Can you talk about the information on the map?Okay.Let's read the first piece of information.Can you speak out the sentence?Great.It is about 1,400 kilometers from Shanghai to Beijing.Now please look at the map again.Can you find some lines on the map?What do they mean?Which sentence can you think of?We can travel from Shanghai to Beijing by train or bus.We can travel from Shanghai to Beijing by train or by plane.Then how about by plane?Can you say it in another way?Excellent.We can say by air.Now look at the map.What information can you get from this map this time?Right.It takes about 1 hour and 50 minutes to travel from Shanghai to Beijing by plane.You have done a good job.In this stage, you will hear three sentences.Take out your worksheet.Please write down what you hear in task three.I will read each sentence three times.It is about 2,800 meters from my home to school.We can travel from Shanghai to Tokyo by sea.It takes about 1 hour and a half to get there by underground.Okay, let's see the sentences.Have you got all these sentences right?Now, read these sentences again.Can you ask questions about the underlined parts?Please write down your questions on your worksheet.Shall we check the questions?How far is it from your home to school?Here, in the second sentence, you can see the phrase by sea.Yes, we can say by ship.So, how do we ask the question?How can we travel from Shanghai to Tokyo?How long does it take to get there by underground?Very good.You see, we have only one big box left.Let's open it now.Miss Guo has got some information about a city.Please read the information.Can you guess which city it is?Now, can you tell me which city it is?Yes, it is Shanghai.Miss Guo's cousin lives in Beijing.She has never been to Shanghai.She wants to know something about the city.Can you make quiz cards for her to ask questions about Shanghai?Read the information again.You will find two empty quiz cards in task four.Write down your questions there.Two minutes for this task.Let's get started.Time is up, let's check.Look, here is your classmate Sally's work.What do you think of the first question in quiz card 1?Do you agree with her?Which city is the capital of China?Well, we use this question to ask about Beijing.Shanghai is not a capital city.So when we ask about Shanghai, we say,What kind of city is Shanghai?Do you still remember how to introduce a city?Please look at the questions on your quiz cards again.On quiz card 1, the first question,What kind of city is Shanghai?Shanghai is asking about the position of the city.The second question, where is it?Is asking about the location of the city.The third one is about the distance between two cities.And the fourth one is about the travelling time between the two cities.On quiz card 2, the first question is asking about the population of the city.The second one is asking about the famous local food in the city.The third one is about the famous places in the city.The last one is about the popular activities for tourists.So we can introduce a city from these aspects.Now, can you introduce Shanghai to Miss Guo's cousin according to the quiz cards?Before we start our introduction, let's design a checklist.We may see if we can introduce Shanghai well with the checklist.Here is my checklist.我是否介绍了所有的重要信息呢?Have I talked about all the important information?我是否有条理地介绍了这个城市?Have I put the information in a good order?我的英语口语是否清晰?Is my spoken English clear?At last, don't forget to give yourself a grade.Now, it's your turn to say something about Shanghai.You will have three minutes to prepare.是否有条理地介绍了这个城市呢?有没有什么重要的地方可以介绍呢?
